model.title: Student Protection and University Accountability Act
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would require colleges and universities to increase transparency in how they handle civil rights matters, including their policies and procedures for addressing discrimination and other civil rights issues on campus.
